template.name: Bollinger Band Width Breakout
template.entry_long: bb_upper(close,{p0},{p1}) - bb_lower(close,{p2},2) > sma(bb_upper(close,20,2) - bb_lower(close,20,2),20) and close > bb_upper(close,20,2)
template.notes: Bollinger(20,2) width above its 20-bar mean plus an upper-band pierce approximates the documented deviation breakout and mean exit. The exact width statistic and StopMultiplier=2 are not fixed percentage fields.
